verdict.rationale: Reducto's Extract endpoint is explicitly designed for this: developers define a JSON schema and Reducto returns matching structured values, with additional support for citations (bounding boxes) tying extracted fields back to source text, confirmed via docs and a live OpenAPI spec exposing /extract and /extract_async endpoints. Missing for 10: independent hands-on accuracy validation beyond vendor claims (community notes some accuracy tradeoffs on long documents, but this doesn't dispute the core schema-based extraction capability itself).
